title: US Foods® Launches SIGNATURE™ Solutions to Help Hospitality Operators Elevate Guest Satisfaction, While Reducing Operational Burdens
summary: Comprehensive Suite of Tools and Resources Help Reduce Operational Waste, Improve Labor Efficiency and Drive Traffic for Hotel and Lodging, Casino and Gaming, Banquets and Catering, and Entertainment Venue Foodservice Operators US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE: USFD), one of America's largest foodservice distributors, today announced the launch of US Foods SIGNATURE™, a new comprehensive program designed to help hospitality operators across four hospitality operation types: hotel and lodging, casino and gaming, banquets and catering, and entertainment venues, reduce operational waste, improve staff efficiency for labor savings and elevate the guest experience.
